grades: Entering junior year of high school or older (junior and senior students at local high schools)
name: UM Health-Sparrow Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You can volunteer in one of six teen roles at the hospital. Examples are discharge, patient and visitor guide, bedside DJ and mother and baby. You work one short shift a week.
who_can_apply: Age 16 and entering junior year of high school. Some placements need volunteers to be 17, and the Radiology placement is for ages 17 to 18.
duration: One semester (10 to 12 weeks): one 2 hour shift a week in the school year, or two shifts a week (max 4 hours) in summer
deadline_text: Volunteer applications are temporarily closed and are anticipated to reopen in mid-October.
how_to_apply: Online application on the Volunteering at Sparrow page (or ask for a paper copy at Volunteer Services). Then onboarding (2 to 3 weeks), online orientation, and placement registration links sent to onboarded volunteers.
notes: Expect a criminal background check, proof of MMR, varicella and Tdap immunizations (or titers), and a flu vaccine Nov to March; teens wear a provided smock apron and closed toe shoes. Volunteers must attend at least 75 percent of shifts. Free parking for active volunteers. Volunteer Services phone is on the page. Michigan's youth employment page (Youth Employment Standards Act) says the law covers employers of anyone under 18 including volunteers, so ask the program whether a work permit is needed.
